display.title: Apotheosis: The Salvaging Table
display.subtitle: Break gear down for parts
description: Not every affixed drop is worth keeping. The §dSalvaging Table§r breaks unwanted
magic gear back into §7materials§r and §dgem dust§r — the reagents that fund
